People here often boast of Voat's immune system, superior to anything that exists elsewhere online. Through what essentially amounts to vitriol, people who "can't handle freedom" are driven away, even if this means driving away those who simply prefer dignity to crudity in their every interaction, by giving them the impression that everyone on Voat is an autist with Tourette's governed purely by hate instead of by reason.

Well, I have news for you all: Voat has another immune system. It's called "inviolable principles". Voat does not govern itself according to the will or expectations of any individual or group; it governs itself according to these principles. Voat recognizes its value as founded on these principles. These principles are oft-stated, well-known, and have been diligently adhered to for over five years. They are that of Freedom of Speech, and for the sake of Truth.

Voat does not exist so people can scream curses at each other and thereby feel somehow better about themselves. Voat tolerates this because it is necessary; opposing it would too readily lend itself to opposing Truth (because it is a judgment against a feeling and therefore can be extended beyond mere curse words). It is because of the value -- nay, the necessity of Truth that Voat has persevered for so long, against all odds and despite all attacks, from within as well as without. Speech is the very basis of Logos itself, which means that without speech we do not have rationality, civilization, or the ability to apprehend Logos, either in the form of Good or in the form of Truth.

Voat's second immune system is the one that turns away those too weak to comprehend Logos, specifically those who serve themselves rather than Truth, those who want Voat to conform to their expectations, rather than the demands of Logos.

People who think it is their will that is paramount, rather than the order of the universe itself. People who are confused by rational arguments, who seem to never grasp Truth when it is spoken to them. These people, too, are driven away -- but because of their weak minds, rather than thin skin.

The point is that Voat has never censored or removed anything because of ideas or emotions represented, and neither has it moved closer to this point. Putt refused to divulge the identity of the Angel, whom he explained is just as dedicated to Freedom of Speech as anyone, because doing so would only potentially jeopardize the ability of the Angel to support Voat. Putt made it so that people browsing Voat from work would have the ability to hide posts from their own view that might get them in serious trouble. Putt removed an already self-deleted account to prevent burdensome legal action in pursuit of trademark claims. Putt banned a user from a subverse for making obvious use of a subverse theme to spam what I would personally term subversive propaganda, but then unbanned that user when some of the community objected. Putt has recently warned users to refrain from posting illegal threats of violence because such content will have to be removed if flagged.

None of this has at any point indicated attempts from Voat to censor ideas, discussion, emotions, or certain language from this website. All of it has been justifiable from legal or rational perspectives, never violating the principle of Freedom of Speech, and yet in all cases, and many others throughout the years, people have left Voat, declaring that it is "becoming reddit".

Such people think they are escaping a cesspool, when in reality they are cleansing one. To those who refuse to use a platform if it does not conform to their demands (just like the Jews who rejected Christ because he did not meet their demands of a Messiah); to those more emotional than rational; to those who place desire or will above reason, I say good riddance!
